items.title: Scammers Are Using AI Voice Cloning to Steal Cash — In Person
items.summary: Your phone rings. It sounds exactly like your grandson — panicked, saying he's been in a car accident and arrested. He needs bail money. A "public defender" gets on the line and tells you to put cash in an envelope. Then a courier shows up at your front door to collect it.

items.title: That 'Gift Card Payment' Demand Is a Scam — Hang Up
items.summary:
The phone rings. The caller says you owe money — taxes, a utility bill, a court fine — and the only way to pay today is with gift cards. "Go to the store, buy Apple or Google Play cards, read me the numbers on the back."

No real government agency or legitimate company asks for gift cards. Ever. Gift cards are for gifts. Once you read the numbers, the money is gone and you can't get it back.

What to do: Hang up. If you're worried you owe something, look up the official number yourself and call. Never pay anyone with gift cards. Never read card numbers to anyone on the phone.

The rule: Gift cards are for presents. If someone demands them as payment, it's a scam. Every single time.

Source: FTC.gov — October 2026

items.title: Daily Brief — Windows 11 November update adds File Explorer upgrades and Firefox 160 arrives
items.summary: Windows 11 KB5127936 rolls out November 10 with a customizable right-click menu in File Explorer; Firefox 160 launches the same day with privacy improvements and a refreshed design. Get the Windows update at Settings > Windows Update > Check for updates. Download Firefox 160 free at firefox.com.

items.title: **Headline:** Windows 11 November update KB5127936 brings customizable right-click menu to File Explorer
items.summary: Open Settings > Windows Update and click Check for updates to get KB5127936, or download it from the Microsoft Update Catalog at catalog.update.microsoft.com. After installing, right-click in File Explorer and choose "Customize menu" to turn built-in commands on or off, add "Print," choose which app extensions appear, or hide the app extensions submenu entirely.

items.title: Stop paying for Microsoft Office — LibreOffice 25.2 is free and opens every file you have
items.summary: LibreOffice 25.2 gives you Writer, Calc, Impress, Draw, Base, and Math — completely free, no subscription. Download the Windows installer at libreoffice.org (choose 64-bit MSI). It opens .docx, .xlsx, .pptx and saves back to those formats.

items.title: Get free remote help built into Windows — Quick Assist lets someone you trust see and control your PC
items.summary: Windows 11 includes Quick Assist — a free, built-in tool for safe remote help. No download, no account, no third-party software. Open Start, type Quick Assist, click Help someone, share the 6-digit code.

items.title: Copy multiple things, paste any of them — Windows Clipboard History is free and built in
items.summary: Press Windows key + V to open Clipboard History. If off, click Turn on. Now every copy (Ctrl+C) saves text, links, small screenshots. Press Win+V to see last 25 items and click any to paste. Pin frequent snippets.
